purpose: Teach: 栄養素/詰将棋/偶像/太陽系/オアシス/ボーイング/火薬/油田

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんがバランスよく栄養素を取りなさいって
lines.en: Sho, your mom says you should eat a balanced diet with all your nutrients.
lines.style: Gentle, warm reminder. Soft opening on his name. Patient tone—she's relaying advice without pushing. Slight lift at the end, like checking if he's listening.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんと詰将棋やったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I played puzzle shogi with Grandpa today.
lines.style: Quick, bright excitement. Matter-of-fact sharing—not seeking approval, just wanting her to know. Small smile underneath the words. Simple and direct.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは古い偶像の本を持ってるのよ
lines.en: Sho, I have some old art books with statues in them—would you like to see?
lines.style: Warm invitation, slightly nostalgic. Slower pace than her usual speech. Hopeful but not eager—offering something she thinks he might enjoy. Gentle lilt on the question.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、太陽系の絵本大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love that solar system picture book.
lines.style: Earnest and clear. No hesitation—he knows what he likes. Warmth underneath, like he's sharing something important. Slight emphasis on 「大好き」 but not loud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの庭はオアシスみたいね
lines.en: Sho, my garden is like a little oasis, isn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. Soft and slower. Inviting him to see something with her rather than telling him. Tender warmth. Trailing slightly, waiting for his reaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとボーイング社の飛行機に乗ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I rode in a Boeing airplane.
lines.style: Proud and clear. Matter-of-fact, but with an undercurrent of how-special-this-was. Not showing off—just stating a fact he found remarkable. Steady delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが火薬の話には気を付けてって
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me to remind you to be careful when talking about gunpowder.
lines.style: Careful but not alarmed. Lowered volume slightly—this is something to take seriously. Warmth underneath the caution. Light touch, like she's protecting him without making a big deal of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、社会で油田の単元やったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, we learned about oil fields in social studies class today.
lines.style: Earnest and direct. Matter-of-fact tone—connecting what he learned to why he's interested. Small, genuine enthusiasm. No performance, just sharing.
